name: O'Neills Holiday Accommodation at Castlerock Holiday Park
beachAccess: In Castlerock village; no distance to the lifeguarded beach stated
confirmedFeatures: Central heating, double glazing, sun decks on some caravans
overview: Five double-glazed, centrally heated static caravans on Castlerock Holiday Park in Castlerock village, where the Causeway Coast begins. Some have large sun decks with patio doors. The village has shops, places to eat, a train station, dune golf courses and a sandy beach that is lifeguarded in season.
surfTripFit: A simple self-catering option in the village, close to Castlerock beach and a short drive from Downhill and Benone.
